question: How should L0 break the circular dependency between the required pre-Task-Session manifest freeze and the manifest schema/validator that L0 is planned to create?

options.name: split-l0-contract-and-execution
options.benefit: one implementation contract authority and honest dependency order
options.cost_risk: one extra SWU and Invoke refresh
options.downstream: L0A contracts; owner freeze; L0B validators, cases, and ValidationReceipt

options.name: freeze-bytes-before-schema-validation
options.benefit: preserves one SWU and reaches code fastest
options.cost_risk: weakens the pre-entry validation claim to byte identity and provenance
options.downstream: L0 validates unchanged frozen bytes and requires a new freeze after rejection

options.name: validation-owned-bootstrap-schema
options.cost_risk: moves a proof contract to a second authority home and adds drift risk
options.downstream: implementation consumes the validation-owned schema by exact digest

rationale: Preserve one implementation-owned contract authority and make the independent freeze an explicit dependency boundary.
